analysis.analysis: The overall campaign shows a strong conversion rate of 12.26%, indicating that once users click through, they are likely to convert. However, the click-through rate of 4.65% is above the typical benchmark for social media but may still indicate room for improvement in ad relevance. The average bounce rate of 27% is healthy, suggesting that users are engaging with the landing pages. However, the engagement rate of 6.68% is high, reflecting good content resonance. The Customer Acquisition Cost is relatively low at 3.37, while the Return on Advertising Spend is strong at 7.94, indicating effective spending. Despite these positive indicators, the performance varies significantly across channels, with Email and Facebook showing lower conversion rates and higher costs per acquisition, suggesting potential issues with ad quality or targeting in these areas.
detected_issues: Low conversion rates on Email and Facebook channels
High Customer Acquisition Cost on Facebook
analysis.root_cause_hypothesis: The primary bottleneck appears to be related to ad quality and targeting, particularly on Email and Facebook, which may not be resonating as well with the audience compared to other channels.
business_risks: Potential loss of customer interest due to low engagement on certain channels
Increased costs if low-performing channels are not optimized

recommendations.title: Shift Budget from Facebook to SMS
recommendations.whats_happening: Facebook ads have lower relevance and higher cost while SMS delivers the highest reader response at lowest cost.
evidence: Facebook click-through rate of 4.0 percent and customer acquisition cost of 4.40
SMS click-through rate of 7.0 percent and customer acquisition cost of 0.83

what_you_should_do.step: Decrease Facebook daily budget by 20 percent
what_you_should_do.how: Adjust the daily spend slider to reduce Facebook allocation by 20 percent
guardrails: Maintain minimum Facebook spend to preserve basic reach
Ensure daily budget does not drop below platform minimum

what_you_should_do.step: Increase SMS spend by the same dollar amount
what_you_should_do.how: Allocate the freed budget into SMS messaging spend
guardrails: Cap message frequency at four sends per user per week
Monitor opt-out rate to remain below 1 percent

recommendations.why_this_matters: Moving dollars to a more relevant channel will raise overall reader response and cut acquisition cost.

expected_impact.explanation: Allocating more spend to SMS leverages its higher relevance and response to drive overall click-through rate up.

dependency_or_risk: SMS compliance requirements must be met
Risk of increased opt-outs if frequency not monitored

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Compare overall click-through rate and SMS response before and after shift
measurement_plan.success_criteria: Overall click-through rate increases compared to last week
measurement_plan.notes: SMS send timing and volume may affect engagement patterns

recommendations.title: Refresh Facebook Ad Creative to Improve Relevance
recommendations.whats_happening: Facebook ads show lower user interaction and click interest compared to other channels, indicating fatigue or weak messaging.
evidence: Facebook engagement rate of 5.36 percent versus overall 6.68 percent

what_you_should_do.step: Develop two new image and headline combinations
what_you_should_do.how: Create variations emphasizing customer stories and clear benefit statements

what_you_should_do.step: Launch an A/B test in Facebook Ads Manager
what_you_should_do.how: Set up split test with equal budget and compare new creative vs current ads
guardrails: Pause any variant whose click-through rate is 15 percent below control
Limit frequency per ad set to three views per user

recommendations.why_this_matters: Fresh creative will recapture attention and boost how users engage and click our ads.

expected_impact.explanation: New creative aligns better with audience interest, raising interactions and click rates.

dependency_or_risk: Creative assets must be ready in two weeks
Testing may delay if approvals take longer

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Compare engagement and click-through rates of new vs control ads
measurement_plan.success_criteria: New creative exceeds control engagement rate

recommendations.title: Refine Google Ads with Negative Keywords
recommendations.whats_happening: Google Ads shows acceptable interest but includes wasted impressions on irrelevant searches.
evidence: Google Ads click-through rate of 4.72 percent
Conversion rate of 11.18 percent below top channels

what_you_should_do.step: Review the last 30 days of search query data
what_you_should_do.how: Export queries and identify non-converting terms
guardrails: Ensure report covers at least 1,000 queries

what_you_should_do.step: Add top irrelevant queries as negative keywords
what_you_should_do.how: Upload the list of irrelevant terms as negatives in phrase match
guardrails: Monitor weekly impressions to avoid drop over 10 percent

recommendations.why_this_matters: Filtering out low-value queries focuses budget on high-intent searches, raising relevance and clicks.

expected_impact.explanation: Removing irrelevant searches concentrates ad exposure on users more likely to click.

dependency_or_risk: Access to search term report required

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Track Google Ads click-through rate before and after negative keyword list
measurement_plan.success_criteria: Click-through rate increases compared to prior period
measurement_plan.notes: Sample size may change if reach shifts greatly

recommendations.title: Segment Email List and Personalize Content
recommendations.whats_happening: High bounce on email links suggests messages are not relevant to all recipients.

what_you_should_do.step: Create two audience segments by purchase frequency
what_you_should_do.how: Divide list into frequent buyers (3+ per year) and infrequent buyers
guardrails: Use past 12 months of data only
Ensure each segment has at least 5,000 addresses

what_you_should_do.step: Send tailored email to each segment
what_you_should_do.how: For frequent buyers include loyalty rewards; for infrequent include product intros
guardrails: Limit send frequency to one email per week per segment

recommendations.why_this_matters: Customized content aligns with recipient needs, raising interest and reducing drop-off.

expected_impact.explanation: Personalized messages boost relevance and reader engagement with links.

dependency_or_risk: Risk of misclassification if data is incomplete

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Compare segment click-through rate and bounce rate before and after
measurement_plan.success_criteria: Click-through rate increases and bounce rate decreases from prior campaign
measurement_plan.notes: Seasonal purchase cycles may affect engagement

recommendations.title: A/B Test Landing Pages for Instagram and TikTok Traffic
recommendations.whats_happening: Users from Instagram and TikTok may not see page content aligned with ad promise, limiting satisfaction.

what_you_should_do.step: Develop two new mobile landing page variants
what_you_should_do.how: One with video testimonials, one with detailed product features
guardrails: Maintain page load time under 3 seconds
Ensure mobile layout matches ad style

what_you_should_do.step: Set up A/B test for each traffic source
what_you_should_do.how: Route Instagram and TikTok clicks evenly across control and two variants
guardrails: Allocate at least 1,000 visits per variant
Stop test if any variant underperforms control bounce rate by 10 percent

recommendations.why_this_matters: Matching page content to ad message keeps users engaged longer and reduces drop-off.

expected_impact.explanation: Tailored landing pages meet audience expectation, lowering bounce and raising time on page.

dependency_or_risk: Requires developer support to build variants
May conflict with existing tracking tags

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Compare bounce rate and time on page for variants vs control
measurement_plan.success_criteria: Bounce rate decreases compared to control
measurement_plan.notes: Traffic mix may shift by day of week
